declaration.negotiation_history_statement: The settlement was reached through four rounds of arm’s-length negotiations. Class counsel initially proposed a $30 million class fund and a $6 million fee request, with automatic distribution and any unawarded fees benefiting the class. Brightline proposed an $18 million fund and $3 million in fees, with automatic distribution and unawarded fees reverting to Brightline. The parties exchanged revised proposals over the next two rounds, negotiating the class fund and fee terms together. Brightline’s Round 3 proposal was a $24 million class fund and $3.5 million in attorneys’ fees, with no clear-sailing provision, unawarded fees reverting to Brightline, and automatic distribution. Class counsel accepted that proposal in Round 4. The fee terms were discussed alongside class relief from the outset, not only after class relief had been agreed.
